entities.summary: Kurtis MacDermid is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Ottawa Senators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played for the Los Angeles Kings, Colorado Avalanche, and New Jersey Devils. MacDermid won the Stanley Cup with the Colorado Avalanche in 2022. He is mostly known as an enforcer.
